Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
LSJ,
I have read this other thread
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_thread/thread/7bc91b7ca3f96bb5/80d94549fa7e6fa2?lnk=gst&q=mirror+walk+venenation#80d94549fa7e6fa2

And I wanted to clarify.

Is Venenation to just add a corruption counter playable after a Mirror
Walk @ [THA]?  There honestly does seem to be a window between "yes
you have blocked me" and "the action ends" or at least that the acting
vampire could sequence and trigger the Venenation before the MW "No
Combat" clause.

----------------------------------
Name: Mirror Walk
[Third:C, KoT:C]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Thaumaturgy
Do not replace until your discard phase.
[tha] +1 stealth.
[THA] As [tha] above, and if this action is blocked, the action ends
(with no combat).
Artist: Brian LeBlanc

Name: Venenation
[FN:C2/PS2]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Serpentis
Only usable when this acting minion is blocked, before combat begins.
[ser] Place a corruption counter on the blocking minion. If the number
of your corruption counters on the minion equals or exceeds the blood
capacity of that vampire or the cost of that ally, you may burn all of
your corruption counters on that minion to gain control of him or her
(combat is canceled). Otherwise, combat occurs as normal.
[SER] As above, but the cost of this card is reduced by 1 blood.
Artist: Brian LeBlanc

This answer seems pretty straightforward:

"Mirror Walk ends the action when it is blocked. You cannot play
Change
of Target after the action ends. Likewise Venenation, Revelation of
Despair, etc."

Messages.Author: cthulukitty
Messages.Body:
Juggernaut wrote:
> It seems like an illogical moment to have one card cut off combat
> before you have the chance to action-mod or reaction against the
> "successful block".  I can understand that you couldn't not have both
> Venenation AND Mirror Walk ending combat (because of stealing a minion
> with venenation) but it does seem that there should be a window.
> "has this minion been blocked" = yes
> Window opens
> [cards playable when a block occurs go here]
> [effects of all cards playable when the block occurs]
> Window Closes
> Action Ends (from Mirror Walk)

The rules and card text could have been written that way, but they
weren't. Mirror Walk states pretty clearly that the action ends once
it is blocked, so that's what happens. What's illogical about that?

Jesse

Jesse,
Sequencing Rules.

As the acting Methuselah, I get to order what events happen "at the
Block Succeeds" moment.  While I can't stop the "action ends" from
Mirror Walk, there seems to be no reason why I couldn't add in other
"Block Succeeds" triggered action modifiers, or conversely from the
blocker (e.g. Obedience, etc) in response to anything from my end.

There doesn't seem to be a reason why I can order sections of my untap
phase (Untap Cards, Order "At the beginning of your Untap Phase do X"
effects, then Order "During your untap phase do X" effects and then
order "Before your Master Phase do X" effects) and not also be able to
insert other effects triggering from "Block Succeeds" so that Mirror
Walk's "End Action" happens later.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
On Dec 1, 4:06 pm, Juggernaut1981 <brasscompo...@gmail.com> wrote:

> Sequencing Rules.

> As the acting Methuselah, I get to order what events happen "at the
> Block Succeeds" moment.  While I can't stop the "action ends" from
> Mirror Walk, there seems to be no reason why I couldn't add in other
> "Block Succeeds" triggered action modifiers, or conversely from the
> blocker (e.g. Obedience, etc) in response to anything from my end.

> There doesn't seem to be a reason why I can order sections of my untap
> phase (Untap Cards, Order "At the beginning of your Untap Phase do X"
> effects, then Order "During your untap phase do X" effects and then
> order "Before your Master Phase do X" effects) and not also be able to
> insert other effects triggering from "Block Succeeds" so that Mirror
> Walk's "End Action" happens later.

Obedience (Kiss of Ra, et al) has all ready set a precedent for what
you are inquiring. Once Obedience has been played its effects happen,
action ends and no further modifiers or reactions can be played. Once
Mirror Walk has been played and its requirement has been met (being
blocked) its effect sets off and no other mods or reactions can be
played. Because of its delayed effect you can, however, play mods and
reactions before its requirement is met. It seems consistent.
